title: RootsInitParams
description: roots.init's params: the local directory, permanent identity, and optional configuration inputs semiont init takes.

path.description: Existing local directory in which to create the knowledge base.

domain.description: The permanent did:web domain, in colon-path form, such as owner.github.io:repo.

name.description: Project name. Absent: the directory basename.

siteName.description: Human-readable site name. Absent: the project name.

inference.description: Inference provider for the generated local stack documents.

model.description: The primary model bound to roles and jobs.

modelLight.description: A light model example emitted in the generated config.

embedding.description: Ollama embedding model name, without the ollama: prefix.

configName.description: Inference document name. Absent: the provider name.
